info.title: llm-hub
info.description:
Single-binary LLM proxy. One port speaks OpenAI chat completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages, and routes by `<profile>/<model>`. The `/api/*` routes feed the dashboard. The dashboard itself (any other GET path) is a web UI and is not part of this document.

Auth: when `LLM_HUB_MASTER_KEY` is set or a hub API key exists, every `/v1/*`, `/api/*`, `/openapi.json` and `/api-docs` request needs a key. With neither, auth is off and any or no key is accepted. `/healthz` never needs a key.

post.description: Anthropic Messages API. The model must be `<profile>/<model>`. The hub forwards natively to Anthropic-capable upstreams and translates for the rest. Fallback and transform headers (`X-LLM-Hub-*`) apply. The hub reports errors in the Anthropic error envelope.

200.description: Message, or an SSE stream when `stream` is true

400.description: Malformed body, unprefixed model, unsupported image source or oversized body.

get.description: Pass-through, not a typed API. The hub forwards any `/v1/*` path that has no dedicated route to the upstream profile its target model names, and returns the upstream response unchanged (status, headers, body, SSE stream). The target comes from the `model` field of a JSON body (or a multipart `model` part), written `<profile>/<model>`. The hub strips the profile prefix before it forwards. Known examples: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/responses`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`, `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens`. Request and response shapes are those of the upstream provider, so this document does not describe them. Optional `X-LLM-Hub-*` request headers set fallbacks, timeout, retry statuses and body transforms. `X-LLM-Hub-Model` and `X-LLM-Hub-Attempts` response headers report what served the request. The hub answers 400 when the model has no known profile prefix, 401 on a bad hub key, and 502 when every attempt fails.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Rest of the upstream path, for example `chat/completions`. May contain slashes.

200.description: The upstream response, passed through unchanged. Streams as SSE when the upstream streams.

400.description: Model missing or without a known profile prefix, or body too large.

ApiKeyInput.description: Admin API request body for creating a hub api key.

CopilotPricesInput.description: Admin API request body for the Copilot price refresh interval.

refresh_secs.description: Seconds between fetches; `0` turns the fetch off.

ErrorBody.description: Error envelope the hub returns on a failed `/api/*` or `/v1/*` call.

FallbacksInput.description: Admin API request body for setting the default fallback chain.

InsightsAnalysisInput.description: The model a manual insights analysis runs on, as `<profile>/<model>`.

attempt.description: The salted attempt key, as history shows it.

session_id.description: The caller's raw Claude Code session id; the hub salts it into a worker key.

worker.description: An already-salted worker key, as history shows it.

OutcomeCode.description: What is known about whether a completed Smart Auto attempt did its job.

ProfileInput.description: Admin API request body for creating or updating a profile.

api_key.description: Omitted or empty on update => keep the existing key (write-only field).

keep_warm.description: Omitted on update => keep the profile's current setting; a new profile starts on.

ResolveBody.description: The body of `POST /api/smart-auto/resolve`. Every field is optional.

parent.description: The parent workflow, the same as the `x-llm-hub-smart-auto-parent` header.

policy_handle.description: The parent policy handle, the same as the `x-llm-hub-smart-auto-policy` header.

profiles.description: Comma-separated profiles, the same filter as the `x-llm-hub-profiles` header.

range.description: Window the group came from: `1d`, `7d` (default), `30d`, or `all`.

solved.description: `true` (default) marks the group's open errors solved, `false` reopens its solved ones.
`true` marks the errors solved, `false` reopens them.

api_key.name: x-api-key
api_key.description: Same key as `bearer`, sent as the `x-api-key` header. Needed only when hub auth is on.

bearer.description: Hub master key or an enabled hub API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Needed only when hub auth is on.
